pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Shortcuts" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Desktop/Projects_Archive.zip && mkdir -p ~/Documents/Projects && echo "Project Alpha Documentation" > ~/Documents/Projects/project_alpha.txt && echo "Meeting notes from Q3 planning session" > ~/Documents/Projects/meeting_notes.md && echo "Budget calculations and forecasts" > ~/Documents/Projects/budget.csv && echo "Technical specifications document" > ~/Documents/Projects/tech_specs.pdf && mkdir -p ~/Documents/Projects/images && echo "Image placeholder data" > ~/Documents/Projects/images/screenshot1.png && echo "Logo design file" > ~/Documents/Projects/images/logo.svg && mkdir -p ~/Documents/Projects/code && echo "print('Hello World')" > ~/Documents/Projects/code/main.py && echo "function init() { return true; }" > ~/Documents/Projects/code/script.js
instruction: Create a shortcut that archives all files from the 'Projects' folder in Documents into a single ZIP file and saves it to the Desktop and run it.
evaluator: [ -f ~/Desktop/Projects.zip ] && [ -s ~/Desktop/Projects.zip ] && shortcuts list | grep -i -E '(archive|projects)' && echo True || echo False
